hypothesis: The LOWER_WICK-only gate did not improve the primary <=25% EntryPosition rate and slightly worsened Low-to-Entry despite preserving Fill/Capture within the precommitted loss bounds. Low-centered anatomy shows the frozen State-v3 classifier still labels most target cases DROP at the oracle-low boundary while BUY-state prevalence rises over the following active minutes. For initial DROP/PULLBACK only, retaining the original OR-of-six frozen signals while recomputing the unchanged State-v3 classifier every 1 active minute instead of every 5 active minutes may capture the earliest causal BUY-state transition, improve EntryPosition <=25% and paired Low-to-Entry, and avoid the Fill/Capture loss caused by signal suppression.
